<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Pikkon''' is a fighter of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]], fast and hard-hitting, with a full set of combos. He is the semi-finalist of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]], and you fight him in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] and in a rematch arranged by [[Special:MyLanguage/King Kai|King Kai]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Pikkon is the '''semi-finalist''' of the Otherworld Tournament, hosted by the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament Announcer|Otherworld Tournament Announcer]]: the player who survives the bracket of Buu Saga fighters faces him first, then [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku|Goku]] (Super Saiyan, with his halo) and finally [[Special:MyLanguage/Gogeta|Gogeta]] (Super Saiyan). Unlike the contenders, he doesn't get stronger from round to round. His default stats are:
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:9--> Stage</translate> !! <translate><!--T:10--> Health / melee / ki</translate> !! <translate><!--T:11--> AI tier</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:12--> Semi-finalist</translate> || 805,000 / 33,600 / 30,600 || <translate><!--T:13--> Elite</translate>
|}

<translate>
<!--T:14-->
Bouts end at knockout, so nobody dies. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|Tournaments]] for how bouts work.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
Pikkon flies, moves fast and throws his punches much faster than most fighters.

<!--T:17-->
* '''Ki Wave:''' an orange ki wave.
* '''Ki Barrier:''' he raises a ki barrier to block incoming attacks.
* '''Aerial Combo:''' he knocks you into the air, teleports above you and slams you back down.
* '''Melee Combo:''' he teleports around you and lands three hits.
* '''Ki Charge Strike:''' he charges in wrapped in ki, then teleports behind you for a final blow.
* '''Zanzoken:''' he dodges with the longest Zanzoken, 6 after-image hops.
* '''Teleporting:''' he can also teleport next to his target.

<!--T:18-->
In the tournament he fights on the '''Elite''' AI tier (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:19-->

<!--T:20-->
* The [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] quest '''Otherworld Tournament''' (quest 35) is a single fight against Pikkon in the Otherworld. It opens after quest 34 of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]].
* [[Special:MyLanguage/King Kai|King Kai]]'s side quest '''Otherworld Rematch''' opens after quest 37 of the Movies Saga: defeat Pikkon again in the Otherworld and report back to King Kai. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Sidequests|Sidequests]].
</translate>
